scope: Wake the archive scanner on new committed images/protocol progress and wake covered S3 output checks after accepted archive proof.
implementation: New published SQL images and protocol-only applied entries with an existing image invalidate only the empty-inventory scan deadline. The single producer, fair batch cursor, capture bounds and per-cell archive failure backoff remain unchanged.

Accepted local archive progress covering a pending receipt moves AwaitFinish to Finish. The normal fresh runtime status, authority, exact receipt, output-proof and waiter deadline checks still decide the response. No success is sent from the archive completion callback.

regression.scenario: Eight sequential actual SQLite/LTX commands with S3 receipts and observed archive coverage, with only the host maintenance poll deliberately set to 1,000 ms. A four-second aggregate bound exposes timer dependence; it is not a production SLO.
regression.original: Three failed reproductions; original first run acknowledged 1/8 within four seconds.
regression.idle_only: Invalidating the empty scan alone still failed, acknowledging 2/8.
regression.fixed: Both wakeups pass the original scenario and 20 consecutive repetitions, with exactly eight business callbacks.
regression.no_proof_changes: The existing outage, corrupt/missing archive, lost-response, expired-waiter, failover and shutdown cases remain required.

non_harness_targets.scope: Production daemon startup/restart/refusal qualification; excluded from the libtest count.

limitations: The focused case demonstrates avoidable timer dependence. Shared-Mac before/after observations, host swap and different binaries do not establish a controlled causal speedup or steady state.

remaining: Sustained S3 traffic acceptance, controlled slow-follower and matched-contract benchmarks, overhead/full-device attribution and density/Q1 qualification.
